newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Dec 9.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Dec 9.

text.p: DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

-------- COMMENTS - Singapore bunker prices were steady on Monday amid very thin talk, traders said. A major said he sold a 1,000 tonne 380-cst parcel at $123 per tonne. Most sellers said there is a lack of 180-cst supplies. They said gas oil, a blend stock used to reduce the viscosity of 280-cst and 380-cst to 180-cst, was also expensive, capping 180-cst supplies further.
